2 Chronicles 13:20 MSG
Jeroboam never did recover from his defeat while Abijah lived…

Yes, let’s look on the “flip” side now…

??
for the rest of your life..
??Every situation you overcame in the past,
?? every enemy you subdued,
??every sickness you recovered from,
??all the evils God delivered you from,
??every failure you recovered from… none, I say none will ever recover from defeat again in Jesus name

He whom the Lord sets free is free indeed. Selah
